family_audit_explicit_evidence: The exact population Regression for learning_rate supplies logistic as inverse link. The exact JGET model is ActionModel(RescorlaWagner()); its continuous default Gaussian report returns Normal(expected_value, action_noise). Regression stores formula/prior/inv_link only; linear_model returns inv_link.(eta) and contains no observation likelihood. The full create_model combines it with the action model.
family_audit_semantic_evidence: This is composite: observed response uses a Normal action likelihood, while the card formula maps covariates to latent learning_rate through a deterministic logistic link with Normal coefficient priors and Normal random effects.

family_audit_negative_evidence: The formula itself has no standalone response distribution; Normal coefficient priors and random effects are not the recovered response family. Frozen loader downloads only the subject table, not the trial responses that supply the likelihood.
family_audit_decision_rationale: Recover the full-model observed likelihood as Normal, explicitly qualified by the linked latent-parameter regression; do not collapse the formula into a standalone Gaussian BRM.
